description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain (%) of different models under the condition of strong supervision. The horizontal axis lists the model names: "Claude-3.5-Sonnet" and "Qwen2-72B." The vertical axis, labeled "Performance Gain (+%)," has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The "Claude-3.5-Sonnet" model shows a performance gain of approximately 10%, while the "Qwen2-72B" model exhibits a performance gain of about 25%. The bars are colored in a shade of blue with diagonal stripes, and the chart includes a legend in the upper right corner indicating the color blue corresponds to "Strong Supervision." The chart does not include any bars that are sorted in a specific way or visually emphasized.
